messages:
Lina: FYI scheduling a tf apply in the quiet window tonight 22:30 UTC. Scope: tighten egress ACLs, add iam tag enforcement, and bump module-network. Need pins and an escape hatch in case routes break.

Rob: Share the small plan excerpt when ready so I can do a quick drift check. Also we should add a pre-apply snapshot of critical route tables.

Lina: plan excerpt (prod):
```
- aws_route.route_east (update)
    - cidr_block: 10.0.0.0/16 -> 10.0.1.0/16
+ aws_iam_policy.enforce_tags (create)
    + name: redwood-enforce-tags
```

DeployBot: DeployBot: job infra-apply-4621 scheduled at 2026-03-21T22:30:00Z. preflight will run and post plan summary. auto-abort if >45 resource changes or if route table deletions detected.

Priya: Please pin provider to hashicorp/aws@3.2.1 and module-network to v2.3.1 in the release branch. Also add a canary: apply to a single AZ before global.

Lina: Done. Created branch `release/infra/egress-iam-pin`. Added canary flag for az-a only and a smoke test step: `scripts/smoke/mesh-check.sh`. Preflight commands I will run:
```
git checkout release/infra/egress-iam-pin
terraform init -upgrade=false -backend-config=env=prod
terraform plan -out=prod.plan -var='env=prod'
terraform show -json prod.plan > prod-plan.json
./tools/plan-audit.py prod-plan.json --rules=iam,egress,route
```

Rob: Add a manual approval gate if plan references any `delete` for aws_route or more than 2 iam policy ARN changes.

Lina: Added a manual hold in the CI with those checks. DeployBot will post the parsed delta and flag for `infra-approve` if tripped.

DeployBot: Parsed plan summary: 12 changes, 0 deletes, 2 iam policy updates. Thresholds OK. Waiting for manual approval: none required.

OpsBot: Automated snapshots created: `route-snapshot-6300001234.json` and `iam-snapshot-6300001234.tar.gz` stored in s3://redwood-infra/snapshots/.

Priya: I'll be on call for rollback. If anything abnormal, execute `terraform apply -target=module.route_restore -var='env=prod'` and then re-run smoke tests.

Rob: Also prepare a release note blurb that lists the module pins and the fallback steps so support can triage. I'll draft one after apply.

Lina: Applying now. DeployBot: please stream logs here and stop + notify on first error. :rocket:

DeployBot: Apply started -> infra-apply-4621. streaming logs. ETA 8m.

DeployBot: Apply complete. 12 resources changed. No deletes. Post-apply smoke: PASS.

Priya: Verified mesh egress path with synthetic requests. All good.

Rob: Drafted release note: "Infra: pinned aws provider to 3.2.1 and module-network v2.3.1; added IAM tag enforcement policy; tightened egress ACLs. Rollback: run `terraform apply -target=module.route_restore` and restore iam snapshot from s3 if needed." Sending to release-notes channel.

Lina: Thanks team. Closing out thread. If any regressions appear in the next 24h, escalate and we will rollback. :white_check_mark:
